issue_context.title: vite@2.9.2+ handle css @import which is wrapped in a comment statement
issue_context.body:
### Describe the bug

style.css
```
div {
  width: 20px;
}
/* @import url@xxx.css); */
```
main.ts
```
import 'style.css';
...
```

As code shown above, when your code try to bundle a css which contains "@import url()"  which wrapped in a comment statement, vite will treat it as an actual import. 
This bug does not exist on vite version 2.9.1, issue occurs starting at version 2.9.2.

This bugs seems to related to this function: https://github.com/vitejs/vite/blob/main/packages/vite/src/node/plugins/css.ts#L1118


### Reproduction

https://stackblitz.com/edit/vitejs-vite-w9q3fu?file=style.css

review_comments:
Does consecutive `appendLeft` end up respecting the order of imports?
We may want to add a comment to help understanding the use of appendLeft and prepend
```suggestion
    // @charset must be the top-first line, using appendLeft for @import 
    // ensures this order is respected  
    s.appendLeft(0, match[0])
```
Yeah `appendLeft` was used to preserve import order. `prepend` would otherwise reverse the order. Will put a comment.
Oh and `appendLeft` isn't used to make way for `@charset`. It's to only preserve the order like explained above.

Added a comment of

> Use `appendLeft` instead of `prepend` to preserve original `@import` order

Let me know if that's fine too.
